# Tests that fail on the base commit 0ec4055 and in every full run since,
# inherited from upstream: GPU bootstrap precision and CPU/GPU bit divergence.
# The check skips them. A manual run with "known_failures" runs them as a
# report that never fails the check.
#
# A pull request that fixes one of these deletes its line in the same pull
# request. One gtest filter pattern per line.
